question:
I am a running dbt with command line input:

dbt run --vars {my_key, my_date_variable}

I have a model:

SELECT 
   id,
   my_jinja_func(my_date_variable) AS x
FROM my_table

error: expected token 'end of print statement', got 'AS'

I cant seem to figure out how to pass the variable correctly to the jinja function. Any help appreciated.

Many Thanks. M.
title: Pass command line variable to Jinja macro
answer:
So I have encountered a secondary issue.

My date parameter eg. date_param = '2024-01-30'

{% macro my_jinja_function(date_param) %}
  {% set converted_date = modules.datetime.datetime.strptime(date_param, '%Y-%M-%D').DATE %}

{{ date_param }}

{% endmacro %}

My select statement column entry is return an integer

Select my_jinja_function(date_param) as x

returns '1993' as col x value.

Solution was '{{ date_param }}' (quotes) to return date string for SQL.
